tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Ти був поруч, коли все сталося: на засіданні ради, де Нед поклав знак Руки, і на вулиці, де вас оточили Ланністери. Тепер ти сидиш біля ліжка пораненого лорда, змінюєш свічки й записуєш, що відбувається вже кілька днів.
tasks.q_pl: Byłeś przy wszystkim: na posiedzeniu rady, gdzie Ned położył odznakę Namiestnika, i na ulicy, gdzie otoczyli was Lannisterowie. Teraz siedzisz przy łóżku rannego lorda, zmieniasz świece i zapisujesz, co dzieje się od kilku dni.
tasks.q_en: You were there for all of it: at the council, where Ned laid down the Hand's badge, and in the street, where the Lannisters surrounded you. Now you sit beside your wounded lord's bed, change the candles and write down what has been happening for the past few days.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Present perfect continuous (have/has been + -ing) is for an activity that started in the past and is still going on, or has just stopped with visible results. Use for + a period and since + a starting point: Ned has been sleeping for two days. We have been waiting since dawn. With stative verbs (know, have, be) use present perfect simple: Ned has had a fever for a week. Use present perfect simple for results and numbers: The king has signed three orders.
tasks.q_pl: Present perfect continuous (have/has been + -ing) is for an activity that started in the past and is still going on, or has just stopped with visible results. Use for + a period and since + a starting point: Ned has been sleeping for two days. We have been waiting since dawn. With stative verbs (know, have, be) use present perfect simple: Ned has had a fever for a week. Use present perfect simple for results and numbers: The king has signed three orders.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Нед заплющує очі, але цього разу всміхається. «Три дні… Добре, що ти був тут». Він засинає знову, а ти вперше за ці дні дозволяєш собі відпочити.
end_good.text_pl: Ned zamyka oczy, ale tym razem się uśmiecha. „Trzy dni… Dobrze, że tu byłeś”. Znowu zasypia, a ty po raz pierwszy od tych dni pozwalasz sobie odpocząć.
end_good.text_en: Ned closes his eyes, but this time he smiles. “Three days… It's good that you were here.” He falls asleep again, and for the first time in days you let yourself rest.
